authorization: User requested common guard implementation for native and agent paths and a Torch qualification/timing kit across the existing grid
guard: After completed ANN, if count<min(k,eligible_count), replace partial result with exact filtered top-k; corruption errors are not converted to fallback
snapshot: All ANN/policy and dedicated exact readers import the keeper's one exported repeatable-read snapshot; keeper locks out writes/rewrites
fallback: Separate persistent exact reader, forced sequential scan, ORDER BY cosine distance,id LIMIT10; same predicate/vector; never append or cache labels as serving results
agent_path: Same C checkpoint/decision path with always-continue arm6; no fresh agent generated yet. Historical arms1/2 and forced arms3/4/5 are qualification probes only
quality: All3150 requests at every grid point for both families; match raw ANN against verified prior sweep, guarded outputs/eligibility/recall against verified exact SQL truth

timing.order: 4-label Williams row [0,1,3,2], rotate by query/epoch/filter/effort, mirror second epoch and query order; reverse effort order in epoch2, rotate filter order
timing.endpoint: Full guarded_request timer: query construction, initial ANN including policy features/decision/continuation, initial decoding, count/validity check, exact dispatch/fetch/decoding when needed, final result validation
timing.outside_timer: Connection/snapshot/map setup, warmups, checkpoint receipt query, recall/eligibility comparison against truth, raw file output
timing.selection_weight: Equal mean of six scalar-filter means on native_guard, both labels/epochs; unfiltered separate control
timing.control_interpretation: A/B differences and native/noop overhead are development diagnostics, not confirmatory speed claims or independent allocations
timing.tie: Within1% of lowest cost choose larger ef_search
timing.repetitions_independence: 450 independent development vectors, not repetitions or7 predicates

adequacy: Native guard and no-stop guard must have complete unique eligible finite results, mean recall>=.95 per condition; no-stop initial/final outputs and fallback decisions identical to native
selection: Fastest observed adequate common native_guard setting by fixed weighting/ties; retain all grid results, no automatic expansion
selected_parent_qualification: Recompute exact truth; capture/forced-prefix proof at16/32/64, local/shared check on10 groups/filter, apply common guard to historical/forced policy probes, verify no-stop/native parity and exact fallback at selected parent
negative: If no adequate hybrid parent, retain bounded negative and do not dispatch the agent
completion: Independent raw return reconstruction plus scheduler success required; synthetic smoke is not original-graph qualification
scientific_scope: Hybrid completion parent explicitly differs from unmodified native; common guard used for every future agent and baseline request; recall safety still tested separately
